Question.title: Community Question
Question.description: An Islamic discussion question or topic where community members debate with references.

details.description: Detailed explanation or context of the question.

category.description: Category such as Fiqh, Hadith, Quran, Contemporary, Aqeedah.

authorId.description: UID of the user who posted the question.

authorPhoto.description: Photo URL of the author if available.

Comment.title: Question Comment & Reference
Comment.description: A debate comment, perspective, or Quran/Hadith reference posted on a question. Requires user sign-up.

questionId.description: The ID of the parent question.

references.description: Specific Quranic ayahs, Hadith citations, or classical scholarly references.

UserMonthlySalah.title: User Monthly Salah Tracker
UserMonthlySalah.description: Tracks the 5 daily prayers (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) for a given month for an authenticated user.

totalCompleted.description: Total prayers prayed in the month.

records.description: Serialized JSON of day-to-day prayer statuses.

AdminPrintableChart.title: Printable Chart or Poster
AdminPrintableChart.description: Uploaded Islamic educational poster or chart managed by administrators.

category.description: Category e.g. Salah & Worship, Duas, etc.

authorEmail.description: Email of the admin who uploaded it

AdminBoardNote.title: Board Curriculum Study Note
AdminBoardNote.description: Academic study note uploaded by admins for IGCSE, CBSE, NCERT, or SSC boards.

board.description: Board code: IGCSE, CBSE, NCERT, or SSC

GeneralNote.title: Notes & Study Material
GeneralNote.description: Comprehensive typed notes, articles, and computer-uploaded files.

category.description: Subject or category (e.g. Quran & Tafsir, Fiqh, Islamic History, General)

content.description: Full typed notes, lesson content, or text

attachments.description: JSON serialized list of files uploaded from computer

EmailVerification.title: Email Verification Code
EmailVerification.description: Stores 6-digit verification codes sent to users for login and signup.

used.description: Whether the code has been used

SiteVisitCounter.title: Site Visit Counter & Analytics
SiteVisitCounter.description: Stores overall and daily visitor traffic analytics for Centre of Islam.

totalVisits.description: Aggregate count of page views and visits

uniqueVisitors.description: Count of unique visitor sessions identified

todayVisits.description: Visits recorded for the current day

lastVisitAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent visit

/analytics/{docId}.description: Website visitor counts and traffic metrics.

/questions/{questionId}.description: Collection of community discussion questions and debate topics.

/questions/{questionId}/comments/{commen.description: Subcollection of comments and textual references for a specific question.

/users/{userId}/salahMonthly/{monthKey}.description: Monthly salah tracking records for a specific user.

/printable_charts/{chartId}.description: Printable charts and wall posters uploaded by administrators.

/notes/{noteId}.description: Notes and study material uploaded or typed by administrators.

/email_verifications/{verificationId}.description: Verification codes sent to user emails for login/signup.

/board_study_notes/{noteId}.description: Board study notes uploaded by administrators.
